record.body:
## Orientation

Work only in ~/se-workflow on branch feat/dashboard-ui (HEAD 38c2399). Build on `load_task_detail(target, work_item_id) -> TaskDetail` in `scripts/dashboard_model.py` (dataclasses TaskDetail, LinkedTask, AcceptanceRow, CheckRun, TimelineEvent, RelatedRecord). Task table rows in `scripts/dashboard_app.py` already use TaskRow.id as row key. The loader makes 3 CLI calls, so load it off the UI thread. Follow the existing test style in `tests/test_dashboard_app.py`. Save PNG screenshots of the detail screen at 60 and 160 columns against the real store (read-only) under /tmp/dashboard-shots/ for parent review.
